$comment: Read by scripts/test-runner.mjs. knownFailures: exact test titles that fail on origin/main today (reported as known-fail; the runner warns when one starts passing - remove the entry in the PR that fixes it). fileOptions.testTimeoutMs: node's per-test limit for one file (a test that never finishes is cancelled by node, reported as a failure, and the file still runs its remaining tests and exits). knownNoExit: files whose process stays alive after every test finished. kindOverrides: a file mapped to a kind when the static classification is wrong.
